name: lockdown-check
description: Security self-check: list approval-gated skills, open sessions, and risky configs.
steps: list enabled skills at L3+ with their cautions
list active gateway sessions and background jobs
report anomalies: unknown sessions, over-permissioned skills, missing approvals
validation: report covers skills, sessions, and a clean-or-flagged verdict
failure_recovery: report partial data with the unreachable part named
cautions: audit only: this skill changes nothing
never reveal approval payloads or secret material in the report
